_about: Everything the chat agent says in a thread at /chat/<id>. There is no AI: the app picks one of these and fills in the words in curly brackets from the dummy company data.
_typingAbout: How long the typing dots show before a reply lands, in milliseconds.
_titleAbout: A chat is named after its first prompt, cut to this many words.

answer.one: 1 of {total} companies matches. It is shown below.
answer.other: {count} of {total} companies match, ranked by ICP fit score.

results.none: No companies match all of those filters. Remove a filter below to widen the search.
results.unfiltered: With no filters left, here are all {total} companies, ranked by ICP fit score.

notJudged.one: {names} has no {fields} data on record, so it was not judged. It is not counted above.
notJudged.other: {names} have no {fields} data on record, so they were not judged. They are not counted above.

brief.lead: {company} is {phase} with an ICP fit score of {score}.
brief.noWhyNow: There is not enough evidence on record yet to say why now.
brief.noContacts: No contacts are on record yet.
brief.openFull: Open the full account page from the panel for the landscape, momentum and every signal.

icp._about: The Refine by ICP pill under a result. Its wording and the chip labels come from the existing Refine by ICP copy in src/data/vendorProfile.js, so the two places always match. This is the only extra line it needs.
icp.nothing: Your vendor profile has no technologies, size band or industries yet, so there is nothing to refine by.

noMatch.text: I could not match that yet. This prototype understands technologies, hiring, decision phases, industries and company names. Try one of these:
prompts: SAP ECC customers not on S/4HANA
Prep an account brief for Coca-Cola

notFound.title: Chat not found
notFound.body: It may have been started in another browser. Start a new one instead.
